verdict.rationale: Logseq offers plugins, an HTTP API, and a URL protocol for external triggering, but there is no evidence of any built-in mechanism for scheduling or running autonomous background automations (e.g., scheduled agent tasks, background jobs) — it requires manual invocation or third-party plugin development. Missing for 10: no documentation of native scheduling/autonomous background execution, no evidence of an automation/agent framework, no independent confirmation of such a feature working.
